u: This man page only documents the hardware-specific features of the everups driver. For information about the core driver, see nutupsdrv(8).
This driver should recognize the NET *-DPC and AP *-PRO models.
This driver does not support any extra settings in the ups.conf(5).
This UPS can only switch off the load if it’s running on battery. This means you may be vulnerable to power races if your shutdown scripts don’t sleep and force a reboot.
